title: ttl-live Live Emote
description: A graphical emote carried by a LIVE comment or emote message. Optional fields are omitted when the wire did not carry them; they are never filled with a guessed default.

shortcode.description: The textual shortcode (for example "[laughcry]"), only when reliably known.

imageUrl.description: Artwork URL from the protobuf ImageModel.

index.description: Raw EmoteWithIndex.index. Its unit is not confirmed, so it is preserved unmodified and never used to slice text.

emoteType.description: Raw EmoteModel.emote_type enum value when non-zero.

packageId.description: Original package identifier for creator-specific or custom emotes.
